Boundaries.Name: dispatch-final-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Retain the logical dispatch owner through underlying native inspection, user conversion and cleanup. Rent ErrorObservation only at the first handled or final failure. Preserve the underlying ValueTask status, continuation flags and original exception.

Boundaries.Name: dispatch-owner-start
Boundaries.Contract: Establish the response owner before invoking dispatch preflight. Synchronous failures complete the same owner after dispatch unwinds; pending operations transfer final inspection to GetResult.

Boundaries.Name: facet-owner-start
Boundaries.Contract: Span-capable facet ownership starts before preflight. Synchronous preflight failure finishes after unwinding; attachment retains ownership through final response inspection and cleanup.

Boundaries.Name: facet-owner-attach
Boundaries.Contract: Span-capable facet ownership starts before preflight. Synchronous preflight failure finishes after unwinding; attachment retains ownership through final response inspection and cleanup.

Boundaries.Name: facet-preflight-final
Boundaries.Contract: Span-capable facet ownership starts before preflight. Synchronous preflight failure finishes after unwinding; attachment retains ownership through final response inspection and cleanup.
